diagram_math_checks.result: U and U_b are global unitary gate occurrences on the fixed ordered n-qubit register; rho, sigma, and each defined sigma_b are density operators on that same space. sigma=U rho U^dagger is precisely the Definition gate update (lines 38–41). The root has exactly one outgoing arrow to the measurement.

P_b=(I+(-1)^b M)/2 and p_b=Tr(sigma P_b) use the post-gate input sigma. The two arrows are labelled b=0,p_0 and b=1,p_1; sigma_b=P_b sigma P_b/p_b is used only for p_b>0. These are Definition lines 42–48 and the supplied def-qc-pauli-measurement-branch-semantics. lem-qc-pauli-measurement-projectors steps 2.1 and 3.1 supply complementary projections and nonnegative weights summing to one.

Each branch marker explicitly distinguishes sigma_b for p_b>0 from bottom for p_b=0. Downward arrows to U_b are labelled p_b>0 only, so no map is applied to bottom. The caption explicitly excludes evaluated descendants of zero-weight edges, matching Definition lines 50–56. U_0 and U_1 are fixed by their observed history b; each has one arrow to terminal U_b sigma_b U_b^dagger, matching the deterministic classical-control and gate clauses.

The visible schematic has eight labelled positions and seven directed downward edges: one unary gate-to-measurement edge, two measurement edges, two conditional continuation edges and two terminal gate updates. State positions annotate transitions rather than adding new instruction types. No closing edge, cycle, crossing, commutative square, or extra relation is asserted. The definition and supplier arguments stand independently; no proof is replaced by this figure.
